G_wilddet3d.title: WildDet3D二维+三维扩展

H_metrics_only.title: 只发现评分结果

evidence_scope: Main model.json + selected frozen code + actual NV result files. First100 records sampled/file, JSONL line counts scanned. MX read-only verification only for16/53/70. No all-model score or all-image ID equivalence proof.

schema_amendments_pending.detail: v1 enforces score∈[0,1], but WildDet3D actual rank score exceeds1; future protocol must support finite ranking_score with explicit semantics, preserve values; do not clip or renormalize.
Common prediction geometry is feasible; COCO100 cannot replace LVIS300/non-exhaustive labels/WIDER or SKU inclusive geometry without a separately named metric profile.
Keep crop/frame/target semantics/masks/3D/text/landmarks etc as sidecar; do not discard needed task output.
Observed native files may use filename stems; build explicit deterministic lookup, not basename guessing.

implementation.scope: A/B/C/D/E/F/G + model 15 native capture; prediction serialization only; original scoring preserved

fixed_scoring.scope: Protocol assignment is a plan; GT binding and full inference completion are separate statuses.
